clockBefore.query: SELECT t.id,t.directoryName,t.walEnabled,w.writerTxn,w.sequencerTxn,w.suspended,w.bufferedTxnSize FROM tables() t JOIN wal_tables() w ON w.name=t.table_name WHERE t.table_name='stk_st_daily'

rows.query: SELECT ts_code,is_st,cast(timestamp AS LONG) timestamp_micros FROM stk_st_daily WHERE timestamp >= '2026-09-28T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' ORDER BY timestamp,ts_code LIMIT 10001
